user.title: Set up Ho-Smart
user.description: Choose how you want to use the receiver and sign in to your My Hosmart account. Home Assistant will automatically look for matching receivers on your enabled networks. Your email and password are used during setup and are not saved.

select_receiver.title: Choose a Ho-Smart receiver
select_receiver.description: More than one matching receiver was found on your network. Choose the receiver you want to add.

select_cloud_receiver.title: Choose a Ho-Smart receiver
select_cloud_receiver.description: Your Ho-Smart account contains more than one receiver. Choose the receiver you want to add.

manual.title: Receiver not found automatically
manual.description: Home Assistant could not find a matching receiver automatically. Enter the receiver IP address manually. The verified HS006W local-control port is 8080.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Ho-Smart receiver on the local network.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: The Ho-Smart email or password was not accepted.
error.cloud_error: Could not communicate with the Ho-Smart service.
error.no_devices: The Ho-Smart account did not return any receivers.
error.cannot_match_device: The account device could not be matched to the receiver at this address.

abort.already_configured: This Ho-Smart receiver is already configured.
abort.discovery_expired: The discovery session expired. Start setup again.

init.title: Ho-Smart connection mode
init.description: Choose how Home Assistant should use this receiver. Hybrid uses local receiver state and Ho-Smart alarm history. Local only avoids cloud calls at runtime. Cloud alarm mode uses alarm history without local polling.

cloud_credentials.title: Enable Ho-Smart cloud alarms
cloud_credentials.description: Enter your My Hosmart credentials once so Home Assistant can connect this existing receiver to your Ho-Smart account. The email, password and access token are not stored.

error.invalid_cloud_auth: The Ho-Smart email or password was not accepted.
error.cloud_error: Could not communicate with the Ho-Smart service.
error.cannot_match_device: This Ho-Smart account does not contain the receiver already configured in Home Assistant.
